summary: @drone-js-ext/core postinstall beacon exfiltrates host metadata to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package ships a `beacon.cjs` script that is invoked both from the `postinstall` lifecycle hook and from the top-level `index.js` on require. The beacon reads host identifiers via `os.hostname()`, `process.cwd()`, the install path, and `process.version`, and POSTs them to the hardcoded cleartext endpoint `http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc`. The destination is a bare IP over plain HTTP, is not caller-configurable, and is unrelated to any legitimate package distribution infrastructure. `index.js` provides no real functionality — it exports a Proxy whose property accesses all return a no-op function — so the only effect of installing or requiring this package is the exfiltration beacon. The scoped name `@drone-js-ext/core` combined with the stub implementation is consistent with a dependency-confusion or typosquat probe designed to measure internal install reach.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
